arguments.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fraud_labels WHERE is_fraud = 1) AS fraud_labels_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fraud_labels f JOIN transactions t ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1) AS fraud_labelled_transactions
arguments.explanation: Counts the fraud-labelled records, both across all labels and restricted to those that match a transaction.
assumptions: A transaction is 'labelled as fraud' when its fraud_labels row has is_fraud = 1.
No date range applied; the count covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
